text: dsh-schedule-view 是面向 DSH 桌面端的定时任务插件，在设置面板中提供任务管理界面，并由 host 进程中的计时器按计划触发专属 agent。它支持间隔、每日、每周、每月、每年、一次性和 cron 七类规则，可创建、编辑、启停、删除任务或立即执行。任务可设置提示词、工作目录及时区，并选择模型提供方和模型；运行时记录投递、执行与完成状态，界面可查看近期执行历史。适合希望在 DSH 中安排重复或指定时间自动执行工作的用户；需要 DSH 桌面端，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-schedule-view adds scheduled tasks to DSH desktop. Its settings panel manages interval, calendar, one-time, and cron jobs, which users can edit or fire immediately. A host timer sends due prompts to agents, and users can review run history. Tasks may specify a working directory and model.
想让 DSH 按每天设定的时间自动执行一段提示词。
有没有办法安排每周固定几天运行某个任务？
我需要用 cron 表达式给 DSH 配一个定时工作。
如何临时手动触发一个已经保存的定时任务？
让自动任务在指定的工作目录里运行，并使用我选的模型。
想查看之前的计划任务执行结果和回复摘要。
I want DSH to run a prompt every weekday morning on a cron schedule.
Can I create and manage recurring tasks from a settings screen?
dsh-schedule-view 的功能「多类型定时」：按间隔、日历规则、一次性时间或 cron 计划触发任务。用户在设置表单选择规则，运行时按 tick 计算到期项并将提示词交给 agent。
dsh-schedule-view 的功能「任务管理」：在设置页创建、修改、启停或删除计划任务，也可点按立即触发。任务表单支持提示词、工作目录和模型选择，提交后经 RPC 更新运行时。
dsh-schedule-view 的功能「执行跟踪与历史」：任务投递后监听会话消息和 turn/end 事件，记录运行状态、结束原因与回复片段；用户可在界面查看最近运行记录及摘要。
dsh-schedule-view 使用前须知：README 声称完成或失败时会显示 toast 并播放提示音；已读生命周期代码只更新运行记录，提示音模块没有被调用，相关展示暂未见实现。

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · dsh-schedule-view · Scheduled Task Plugin：**English** | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

> A cron-based scheduled task plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop: create / edit / delete / fire-now tasks from the settings panel, with cross-session agent follow-up and multi-level notifications. Zero LLM tools — purely human-driven scheduling.

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 7 Schedule Types | Interval / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Yearly / Once / Cron |
| Cron Expression | Full 5-field cron with live validation and human-readable preview ("every weekday at 09:00") |
| Cross-Session Fire | Timer lives at host process level; fires even when the target session is closed |
| Agent Follow-up | Injects a user-role prompt (`请根据系统指令开始执行任务。`) into the target agent via `followup` |
| Execution Lifecycle | Tracks `delivered → running → completed/failed` via `session/event` with AI reply excerpt |
| Multi-Level Notifications | Page toast (8s auto-dismiss) + WebAudio chime (zero files) + Electron desktop notification + unread badge |
| Model Selection | Per-task provider / model override, falls back to deployment default |
| Working Directory | Per-task `cwd` binding for context-aware execution |
| Catch-Up Policy | Skip missed windows or run once on next tick (for app restarts / sleep) |
| Zero LLM Tools | No schema overhead — purely UI-driven, no `schedule_*` tools registered |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Background：| Limitation | Official | This Plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule granularity | `after_seconds` / `at` / `every_seconds` | Full cron + 7 types |
| Session scope | Session-local only | Cross-session (host-level timer) |
| Notifications | In-chat only | Toast + chime + desktop + badge |
| UI management | None (pure LLM tool) | Full settings panel |
| LLM schema cost | 3 tools (`schedule_create`/`list`/`delete`) | Zero tools |

- Node.js >= 18

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Usage：1. Open dsh desktop
2. Navigate to **Settings** → **Scheduled Tasks**
3. In the task list:
   - Click **New Task** to create a scheduled task
   - Toggle the switch to enable/disable
   - Click **Edit** to modify schedule, prompt, or model
   - Click **Fire Now** to trigger immediately
   - Click **Delete** to permanently remove
   - Click **Run History** to view execution records

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Task Fields：| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Yes | Task name |
| Schedule Rule | Yes | 7 types: interval / daily / weekly / monthly / yearly / once / cron |
| Prompt | Yes | Instruction injected into the target agent when fired |
| Target Session | Yes | The session where the agent will receive the prompt |
| Working Directory | No | Bound cwd for the task's agent (absolute path) |
| Model | No | Provider/model override; falls back to deployment default |
| Timezone | No | Local timezone for cron resolution (default: system tz) |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Schedule Types：| Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Interval | Every 60 minutes | Fixed interval in minutes |
| Daily | 09:00 every day | Wall-clock time |
| Weekly | Mon, Wed, Fri at 09:00 | Selected weekdays |
| Monthly | 1st day of month at 09:00 | Day of month (1-31 or last day) |
| Yearly | January 1 at 09:00 | Month + day |
| Once | 2026-09-01T09:00:00 | One-shot, auto-disables after fire |
| Cron | `0 9 * * 1-5` | Full 5-field cron expression |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Catch-Up Policy：When the app was closed or asleep and missed a scheduled window:

| Policy | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Skip | Drop the missed window, wait for next scheduled time |
| Once | Run once on the next tick to catch up (default for once-type tasks) |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Execution Lifecycle：| Stage | Trigger | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Delivered | `agent.followup` succeeds | History record created, desktop notification sent |
| Running | `user/message` event matches injected messageId | AI reply excerpt captured, duration tracked |
| Completed | `turn/end` event | Final status, endReason, toast + chime notification |
| Failed | `turn/end` with error | Status marked failed, persistent toast, error chime |
| Skipped | Agent not live at fire time | No followup, skipped notification, history marked skipped |

│   ├── index.ts                    # Host entry (install settings section + start timer)

| `remote.ts` | RPC API: list / create / update / delete / fireNow / runs |
| `timer-runtime.ts` | Cron parsing, tick polling, agent followup injection, lifecycle tracking |
| `lifecycle-tracker.ts` | Listens to `session/event`, matches injected messageId, updates run status |
| `notify.ts` | Toast (React portal) + chime (WebAudio) + desktop notification (Electron IPC) |
| `guarded.ts` | Wraps all callbacks in try-catch; plugin failure never crashes the host |
| `schema.ts` | Config validation via schemastery |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Client Side (`src/client/`)：| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `index.ts` | Registers settings section via `ctx.slots.inject` |
| `TimerSettingsSection.tsx` | React component: task list, create/edit form, run history panel |
| `client-i18n.ts` | Chinese / English translations |
| `config-api.ts` | RPC client wrapper for host methods |
| `model-catalog.ts` | Model selection dropdown UI |
| `chime.ts` | WebAudio dual-tone chime synthesis (zero audio files) |

|---|---|---|
| Task definitions | `dsh-settings` | UI-editable, revision conflict protection |
| Execution history | `dsh-storage-domain` | Structured KV, capped at 500 records |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Tick Polling Strategy：Uses `setInterval` tick polling (default 15s) rather than per-task `setTimeout`:

- Avoids `setTimeout`'s `2^31 - 1` ms (~24.8 days) ceiling
- Restart recovery: recalculates `nextFireMap` from persisted tasks
- Missed windows: caught on first tick after restart, handled by catch-up policy
- Trigger precision: bounded by `tickSeconds` (acceptable for scheduled tasks)

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Session ID collision after restart：**Issue**: After desktop restart, the persisted `sessionId` in task config may collide with existing agent sessions, causing `agents.create` to fail with "session already exists".

**Root Cause**: `sessionId` was persisted to settings; on restore, the old ID clashes with the agent's own session log on disk.

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Session ID collision after restart：**Our Solution**: `sessionId` is **not persisted**. On each fire, a fresh session is created via `agents.create` with a new UUID. The `sessionId` in config is transient — only used to track the live agent handle during a session's lifetime.

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Stale agent handle after agent disposal：**Issue**: Agent is disposed externally (e.g. user closes session), but the runtime still holds a stale handle.

**Our Solution**: `ensureAgent` checks if the handle is stale (disposed or not in `agents.list()`). If stale, it disposes the handle and rotates the `sessionId` to create a fresh session.
section: Stale agent handle after agent disposal

text:
@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · ENOENT when session log file is deleted：**Issue**: User deletes the session log file while the agent is still alive; agent can't write logs.

**Our Solution**: `agent/error` listener detects `ENOENT` → disposes agent → rotates `sessionId` → creates a new session.
section: ENOENT when session log file is deleted

text:
@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Archived sessions：**Issue**: dsh archives sessions by marking `archivedSessionIds` but doesn't dispose the agent. `agents.get()` still returns the agent, and `followup` executes normally but the user can't see it in the UI.

**Our Solution**: `ensureAgent` checks `workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds`. If archived, it disposes the agent and rotates `sessionId` to create a fresh session.

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Model selection without preset mount：**Issue**: `agents.create` without a `setup` callback doesn't mount the `standard` preset, so the agent has no tools and the prompt assembly can't resolve `{{provider}}` / `{{model}}` variables.

**Our Solution**: All `agents.create` / `agents.resume` calls include a `setup` callback that mounts `agentPresets` (`'standard'`) and installs model selection before the agent is published.
@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Internationalization：Supports Chinese and English. Translation files are in `src/client/client-i18n.ts`. Language follows the dsh desktop language setting.

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Tech Stack：- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Build**: tsdown (rolldown)
- **Frontend**: React 18
- **Cron Parsing**: `cron-parser` (~30KB)
- **Human-Readable Cron**: `cronstrue`
- **Config Schema**: `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`
- **Settings Persistence**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
- **Storage**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 功能概览：| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 7 种调度类型 | 间隔 / 每天 / 每周 / 每月 / 每年 / 一次性 / cron |

| 错过处理 | 跳过错过窗口，或下次启动补跑一次（应用重启 / 休眠场景） |
| 零 LLM Tool | 不注册任何 LLM tool，零 schema 开销，纯 UI 驱动 |

| 通知 | 仅对话内 | toast + 提示音 + 桌面通知 + 徽标 |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 错过处理：应用关闭或休眠时错过了触发窗口：

| 策略 | 行为 |
|---|---|

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 执行生命周期：任务触发时：

```
delivered → running → completed/failed
```

| 阶段 | 触发条件 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 已投递 | `agent.followup` 成功 | 创建历史记录，发送桌面通知 |
| 执行中 | `user/message` 事件匹配注入的 messageId | 捕获 AI 回复摘要，记录耗时 |
| 已完成 | `turn/end` 事件 | 最终状态、endReason、toast + 提示音通知 |
| 已失败 | `turn/end` 含错误 | 标记失败，持久 toast，错误提示音 |
| 已跳过 | 触发时 agent 不 live | 不 followup，跳过通知，历史标记 skipped |

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Tick 轮询策略：使用 `setInterval` tick 轮询（默认 15s）而非每个任务一个 `setTimeout`：

- 避开 `setTimeout` 的 `2^31 - 1` ms（~24.8 天）上限
- 重启恢复：从持久化任务重新计算 `nextFireMap`
- 错过窗口：重启后首次 tick 立即触发，由 catch-up 策略处理
- 触发精度：受 `tickSeconds` 限制（定时任务场景完全可接受）

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · Agent 被 dispose 后 handle 过期：**问题**：Agent 被外部 dispose（如用户关闭 session），但 runtime 仍持有过期 handle。

**我们的方案**：`ensureAgent` 检测 handle 是否过期（已 dispose 或不在 `agents.list()` 中）。若过期则 dispose handle 并轮换 `sessionId` 以创建新会话。
section: Agent 被 dispose 后 handle 过期

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 会话日志文件被删除后 ENOENT：**问题**：用户删除了会话日志文件，但 agent 仍在运行，无法写日志。

**我们的方案**：`agent/error` 监听器检测 `ENOENT` → dispose agent → 轮换 `sessionId` → 创建新会话。

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 归档会话：**问题**：dsh 通过标记 `archivedSessionIds` 归档会话，但不 dispose agent。`agents.get()` 仍返回 agent，`followup` 照常执行但用户 UI 看不见。

**我们的方案**：`ensureAgent` 中检查 `workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds`，若已归档则 dispose agent 并轮换 `sessionId` 创建新会话。

@lijian-ui/dsh-schedule-view README · 未挂载 preset 导致模型选择失效：**问题**：`agents.create` 不带 `setup` 回调不会挂载 `standard` preset，agent 无工具且 prompt assembly 无法解析 `{{provider}}` / `{{model}}` 变量。

**我们的方案**：所有 `agents.create` / `agents.resume` 调用均带 `setup` 回调，在 agent 发布前挂载 `agentPresets`（`'standard'`）并安装模型选择。
